description: The published digests for one database file, for verifying a copy you already hold or deciding whether a build has changed since you last fetched it. It is licensed like the download itself, so a database this key cannot download is refused here too. Looking up a checksum is not a download and does not appear in `list_downloads`.

dataset_id.description: A VERSIONED database id, from `versions[].id` in `list_databases` - `cdn_ip_v1`, not `cdn_ip`. The unversioned base id is a license reference and is not accepted here.

name: database_checksum
